class.name: IfcFlowTerminal
class.brief_description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowTerminal defines the occurrence of a permanently attached element that acts as a terminus or beginning of a distribution system (e.g., air outlet, drain, water closet, sink, etc.). A terminal is typically a point at which a system interfaces with an external environment. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTerminalType or its subtypes. HISTORY: New entity in IFC R2.0
